speaker: MIRAGE
text: Below the queue, everything is doors and white light. Wait for the scanner to go dark. I will phase us into processing.

speaker: AURA
text: Every denial carries the same harmonic signature. Clear the control hall and I can isolate it without touching the records.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: The archive cooling loop is failing. Let me stabilize it before Titan opens a maintenance route away from the originals.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Three originals: family, residency, and civic registration. Authenticate each terminal. Leave the archive intact.

speaker: KAITO
text: We have their names. Isolate the command, then defend the recovery. No one erases them again.

speaker: SURYA
text: The queue is still here. Food and shelter gates are waiting for the restored register. Send it when you are ready.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Inside. The public queue never had access to any of this.

speaker: AURA
text: Denial signal isolated. Scanners are offline. The originals are deeper in the archive.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Temperature stable. The records are safe. Titan, the damaged maintenance wall is yours.

speaker: TITAN
text: A clean route through damaged concrete. The records stay untouched.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Family register authenticated. Original names recovered.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Residency confirmed. These people belonged here long before the scanners.

speaker: AURA
text: Civic register authenticated. All three originals agree. The exclusion list was fabricated.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Exclusion command isolated. Security is closing on the recovery. Defend the first stage.

speaker: TITAN
text: First recovery secured. Another formation is coming. Keep them away from the console.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Second stage secure. One final formation. Then we give the queue its names back.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Recovery complete. No defenders remain. Commit the identities at the district access terminal.

speaker: SURYA
text: Accepted. The lights have changed. Shelter, water, transit. They are reading names again. Everyone here can finally move.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Use the signature ability named by your objective. The archive terminals respond to your normal context attack control.
